Package parking.domain.model

Interface Rate

All Known Implementing Classes:
HourlyRate, RateWithDailyCap
public interface Rate
Fee-calculation strategy (Strategy pattern).

Every Vehicle owns its own Rate instance through composition, obtained from Vehicle.getRate(). No other class in the system inspects the vehicle's concrete type to decide how much to charge; everything is resolved by invoking calculateAmount(long) polymorphically on whichever Rate the vehicle hands back.
